general: Fanaticism spell will only be available as a Racial Spell
% Reduction Sciences Max Reductions Reduced from -95% to -75% (Bookkeeping, Artisan, Resilience, Shielding, Finesse)
All Doctrines give double bonus for the first province, then scale by the listed amount for each province up to the Max
Dragon Hitpoints Reduced by 10% to accomodate for lower Elite values, Recurring effects after 6 ticks have been removed

races.name: Avian
races.effect: Learn and Plunder attacks return armies 1 tick faster (after modifiers).

races.name: Dark Elf
races.effect: Successful offensive instant spells refund 30% of the rune cost.

races.name: Dryad
races.effect: Successful Attacks in War destroy 15% of enemy gold, 15% of enemy runes, and 15% of enemy food.

races.name: Dwarf
races.effect: For 3 ticks after a successful attack, the target's building efficiency is reduced by 10% (does not stack with multiple attacks).

races.name: Elf
races.effect: Once activated, for the next 6 days, regenerate +2 mana per day.

races.name: Faery
races.spells: Lightning Strike, Town Watch, Invisibility, Ghost Workers, Miner's Mystique
races.effect: (In War) Every successful offensive spell also reduces enemy ritual effectiveness by 0.15%.

races.name: Gnome
bonuses: Can Train Thieves with Specialist Credits
races.effect: Each successful attack will provide one of the following thievery boosts, which last for 6 days: +25% offensive thievery effectiveness, -25% thief losses, or +10% sabotage damage. All of these can be active at the same time.

races.name: Halfling
races.effect: Once activated, your maximum population increases by +25% for 5 days.

races.name: Human
races.effect: Prisoners generate an additional 2.0 gold coins per tick. Mercenary costs are reduced by 40%.

races.name: Orc
races.effect: When attacking with 2 or more generals, enemy military casualties are increased by +15%.

races.name: Undead
bonuses: -40% Own casualities when attacking and defending
races.effect: All successful attacks have a 33% chance to spread plague to the target province.

personalities.name: Cleric
personalities.effect: Incoming Raze damage is reduced by 15%. Your Raze attacks destroy 20% additional buildings.

personalities.name: General
personalities.effect: Your next successful attack applies Coordinated Strike to the target for 4 days, reducing their Watch Tower effectiveness by 15%.

personalities.name: Heretic
bonuses: No Thieves lost on Failed Espionage Operations
personalities.effect: 50% fewer thievery losses when performing sabotage operations.

personalities.name: Mystic
personalities.effect: Successful offensive instant spells also kill 1% of the target's peasant population.

personalities.name: Rogue
personalities.effect: You may perform thievery operations even while overpopulated.

personalities.name: Sage
personalities.effect: Successful attacks in War or Hostile temporarily suppress 15% of the target's Science Effectiveness and reduce Book Generation by 20% for 6-8 ticks.

personalities.name: Tactician
personalities.effect: When attacking with a dragon, 3% of your raw offense from units will also deal damage to the dragon.

personalities.name: Warrior
personalities.effect: Once activated Warriors gain 5% Offensive Military Efficiency for 6 days.

rituals.name: Haste

rituals.name: Havoc

rituals.name: Onslaught
